title: Her father's brass and dance bands and the Algiers roots
summary: She says her father played dance orchestras and brass bands, parades and funerals; his family was from Algiers; Allen mentions Manetta's uncle Norm as a possible teacher.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Well, I think of it. I wonder if there's anything else you could tell us about your father. Since, as I say, we never did get much information about the different bands. You say he played the Eureka. Did he play mostly brass bands or did he play in dance orchestras too?
He played in dance orchestras and brass bands. And brass bands too. Parade bands and all those.
Now, do you remember where he started? Who was his teacher?

Because I know some of Professor Mineta's uncle even, Norm, he always speaks of him as his uncle, Norm, that played trumpet way back even... Well, that probably was his teacher. Might have been his teacher in Boston.

You didn't hear him talk about him much? Well, no. He played a little short E-flat. Norm and Mineta played a little short E-flat trumpet, I think, in the brass bands, mostly brass bands. Did he ever play much in Algiers? Had their family been raised in Algiers too? Your father's family?
They were born and raised in Algiers. Those were there. Uh-huh.
And he practically played all those barades and funerals and all such as that.
